power.my_addon.form_spider_moon_weaver_s: Projectile spells spend 8 web energy per cast: ground impacts leave a roughly 3x3 membrane patch lasting 60–90s; direct effective hits leave no web and have a 15% chance to fully cocoon the target (15s for mobs, 5s for players). Each cast rolls once per target; an unrefreshed curse mark still rolls. Piercing direct hits prevent later web placement. Protected targets are exempt. Insufficient energy casts normally without the bonus or fee. Existing lunar, venom, cocoon, Perk and accessory bonuses remain.
power.my_addon.form_spider_salticidae_sp: An effective leap hit instantly casts a non-red curse from your equipped book at the target. Prefer the selected ready spell, otherwise choose another ready slot randomly. Pay 20% of normal collapse, consume no scroll uses, and retain 10% of the new cooldown. With no ready curse, including all on cooldown, trigger a free random white curse; existing longer cooldowns remain. Inventory scrolls are excluded. Existing curse affinity, leap, Perk and accessory effects remain.
perk.ssc_addon.anubis_wolf_sp.anubis_wol: Reduce passive wolf summoning cooldown to 21 seconds. A wolf's death restores 2 health to you. Keep the crystal's additional summon count. Netherwolf Court retains its 30-second cooldown.

Upgrade passive summons: summon 3 wolves when attacking or 2 when hit, with a cap of 3. With the crystal, these become 4, 3 and a cap of 4. Keep the 21-second cooldown and rank I death healing. Soul Excitation adds one further slot.
Wolves from passive summons, Netherwolf Court and Death Domain gain Strength I for 30 seconds.

Passive: increase the simultaneous wolf cap by 1 for passive, Court and domain summons. Summons per activation stay unchanged; this does not automatically spawn wolves. The active cap rises from 6 to 7, or from 8 to 9 with the crystal.
Wither damage intervals become 1.5 times longer: every 3 seconds for Wither I and 1.5 seconds for Wither II.
Replaces Wither Tolerance I: double Wither damage intervals to 4 seconds for Wither I and 2 seconds for Wither II.
Skill key 3: remove your Wither and recall all wolves, stopping any pending summons. Cooldown: 10 seconds. With Pack Response I learned, each recalled living wolf restores 2 health.
Remove your damage penalty against undead: hits of at least 4 damage no longer lose 3 base damage.

codex.form.my_addon.familiar_fox_sp.titl:
‘When the curse merges completely with the moonlight, you are no longer just a familiar...
You are the agent of the Spirit Realm, master of the Blue Flame’
codex.form.my_addon.familiar_fox_sp.appe: Your body hasn't changed much, but your soul has been thoroughly eroded by the moon's curse. It grants you more power, but also more curses.
codex.form.my_addon.upgrade_familiar_fox:
'You have taken the original familiar as a base and forged an evolution path independent of the original...
On this path, every talent point shapes your unique spiritual form'

Your husk remains that of a familiar, but the mana circuits within have been rebuilt. Freed from the original evolution track, you awaken along an independent talent path — the section below records your awakened abilities in real time as you spend points.

Independent Evolution
You have broken from the original familiar's fixed evolution tree, customizing abilities via talent points. Each unlocked node awakens its power and dynamically appends a book-style narrative to the Appearance page:

Mana System / Spark / Rocket / Buff Immunity / Alchemy / Spirit Vision / Fire Ring / (hidden bonuses: Spark, Rocket and Buff Immunity nodes each also raise max Mana by 10; Buff Immunity plus Alchemy grant 50% magic damage reduction together)  Spirit Lord Branch / Mancianima Branch

Additionally, you retain the familiar's baseline gifts: see-through-walls vision, free passage through sweet berry bushes, a small frame, and agile movement.

Independent evolution demands a higher growth threshold:

All active abilities are mana-driven; depleted mana leaves you skillless.

You must reach level 50 and unlock both branches before using the Moon Essence Cross / Evolution Stone for your final metamorphosis.

Your body remains familiar-based: no leggings or boots, slow in water, and less saturation from food.

You sense two distinct evolutionary potentials whispering within — one the frenzy of moonlight, the other the echo of the Evolution Stone. Both await your final choice after completing your talent path.
codex.form.my_addon.familiar_fox_sp.pros:
Spirit Realm Lord
The magic within you has sublimated into a higher form, granting you unparalleled power:

Blue Fire Ring: You can activate a Blue Fire Ring around you. It continuously consumes mana to damage and inflicting severe burning on nearby enemies. While active, your Soul Reaping ability is greatly enhanced.

Fox Fire Breath: Consumes mana to breathe devastating Soul Fox Fire forward, dealing instant damage and igniting enemies for a long duration.

Soul Reaping: As a spiritual entity, you can draw power from fading lives. Killing targets restores a large amount of mana. If the Blue Fire Ring is active, kills also restore health and energy.

Mana Absorption: drain life essence from creatures for energy and satiation — normal creatures and humans give back generously, hostile creatures return a little along with debuffs. You slowly siphon the Cursed Moon's residual energy from the air. You can also slowly gather residual energy from the previous Cursed Moon from the atmosphere.

Spirit Embodiment: You are no longer mere flesh and blood, but a hybrid of flesh and mana. Thus, you are immune to more status effects, good or bad. With enhanced control over spiritual energy, when your mana is sufficient (Mana above 50), overflowing mana forms a shield around you that persistently reduces damage by 50%.

Additionally, you retain all previous abilities: Illagers see you as an ally, you can see through creatures, and move freely through sweet berry bushes.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Pay 10 Mana per cast to shorten preparation by 25%, with 5% more collapse growth. Uninterruptible phases and animations retain their original speed. Insufficient Mana uses ordinary timing and collapse cost.
codex.form.my_addon.familiar_fox_sp.cons:
Great power requires a huge price to maintain:

As a high-ranking spirit, your dependence on mana is more severe. Low or exhausted mana makes you weak and increases damage taken.

Your physical structure remains fragile; your health is no higher than a normal familiar.
You cannot equip leggings or boots, and move slowly in water.
You gain less saturation from food.
codex.form.my_addon.familiar_fox_sp.inst:
Your control over spiritual power has reached another level, but your soul is more severely eroded by the Moon Curse. You feel yourself losing control over your body, constantly urged to unleash the Soul Fire within and burn everything in your path.
You have become a puppet of the moon, craving destruction and chaos.
You can no longer absorb the moon's mana because your body has reached its limit.
power.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_sp_kill: Restores 10 Mana on kill. If Blue Fire Ring is active, restores an additional 5 Mana and 3 Health; while the empowered fire ring is active with the Blue Fire Amulet equipped, this becomes an additional 10 Mana and 5 Health instead.
power.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_sp_blue: Requires full Mana to activate. Consumes Mana per second to damage and ignite surroundings. Enhances kill restoration when active.
power.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_sp_fox_: Consumes 15 Mana to breathe Soul Fox Fire forward, dealing 6 damage (x3 to non-player creatures) and igniting enemies for 5 seconds.
power.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_sp_abso: Sneak and right-click a mob to drain its life essence: normal creatures and humans give back large amounts of Mana and saturation, while hostile creatures return a little Mana along with Blindness, Slowness and Weakness. Has an internal cooldown.
power.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_sp_no_b: As a powerful spirit, you are immune to poison, hunger, nausea, etc., and fire damage (but still fear Soul Fire).
power.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_sp_debu: Mana < 10%: -20% Attack/Speed/Mining. Mana < 3%: -60% stats and increased damage taken. Running out of Mana is torture.
power.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_sp_mana: Passively regenerates 1 Mana every 0.5 seconds; casting skills pauses regeneration for about 6 seconds. Moonlight keeps flowing back within you.
power.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_sp_init: Start with 100 Mana upon gaining the form, ready for battle.
power.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_sp_dama: Gain 50% damage reduction when Mana is above 50.
item.ssc_addon.active_coral_necklace.des: During Play Dead, replaces healing with 5 hearts and fills absorption up to 20 hearts in total. Full benefit requires all 6 seconds.
item.ssc_addon.sp_upgrade_thing.tooltip: A cross ring condensed from moonlight, allowing you to absorb more curses, but not increasing your max curse tolerance.

Increases Fire Ring damage per hit; radius shrinks from 6 to 3.6 blocks.
message.ssc_addon.evolution.success: “Excellent…” The moonlight whispers in your mind, closer and clearer than ever. With the whisper comes unparalleled power. You embraced evolution, meaning you embraced a deeper hug of the curse. It is a dangerous symbiosis, and you can no longer separate.
message.ssc_addon.red_transformation_spe: You merged with the power of the cursed moon, but your body seems to have temporarily transformed into a 'special' form. You only want to protect your teammates; for them, you can sacrifice your life.
message.ssc_addon.red_revert_timeout: You came back to your senses and realized your appearance had returned to its original form. You felt confused, but how could the characters in the story be real?
item.ssc_addon.lifesaving_cat_tail.toolt: A tail from another cat, perhaps it can prevent death
item.ssc_addon.frost_amulet.tooltip.2: On an ice-ball hit, creates up to 2 homing shards targeting other nearby creatures outside your whitelist. No extra targets, no split.
item.ssc_addon.phantom_bell.desc.1: A bell as cunning as a fox, allowing you to escape in critical moments.
item.ssc_addon.phantom_bell.desc.2: But it might also teleport you to your grave.

message.ssc_addon.evolution_stone.no_res: The Evolution Stone does not respond to your request
item.ssc_addon.coral_ball.tooltip: A colorful ball made of various corals
item.ssc_addon.invisibility_cloak.toolti: Increases True Invisibility duration by 2s, but increases cooldown by 2s.
power.my_addon.form_axolotl_sp_rain_wetn: Slowly restores Moisture (Air) when exposed to rain, keeping you moist even on land.
power.my_addon.form_axolotl_sp_natural_r: Gain a fixed extra 0.75 HP per second, independent of natural regeneration.
power.my_addon.form_axolotl_sp_play_dead: While standing (not sneaking), press the secondary skill key to enter Play Dead state for 6s. Gain Blindness and immobility, remove all mob aggro, regenerate life over time (~15 HP total) and reduce incoming damage by 60%. 31s cooldown.
power.my_addon.form_axolotl_sp_water_bal: While sneaking on ground, press the secondary skill key to trigger a water burst: explosion damage increased by 50%, plus 4 bonus base physical damage. Costs 20 moisture (12 with Water Magic Efficiency). 3s cooldown.
power.my_addon.form_axolotl_sp_water_spe: Sneak + Right Click with an Arrow in offhand to craft a Water Spear. Consumes 10% Moisture and 1 Arrow. Water Spear applies Slowness II for 5s on hit.
power.my_addon.form_axolotl_sp_vortex_im: Press the primary skill key once to start charging, press again to release early, or charge for 4s to release automatically, pulling nearby enemies toward you; the longer you charge, the higher the damage (up to 16). On release, launch enemies and apply Slowness III. Incoming damage reduced by 50% during the skill. Purification cancels the charge without an impact and starts the full 15s cooldown. Unprotected non-player creatures being pulled by the vortex temporarily deal no attack damage to you. A default full charge costs up to 60 moisture, or 36 with Water Magic Efficiency.
origin.my_addon.form_axolotl_sp.name: SP Axolotl
origin.my_addon.form_axolotl_sp.descript: The spiritual evolution of the Axolotl, possessing powerful water skills.
message.ssc_addon.evolution.fail.no_moon: The metamorphosis to the essence requires the cursed moonlight as the final key. At this moment, the keyhole is empty—evolution has fallen silent.
message.ssc_addon.evolution.fail.bad_for: Current form is insufficient to carry echoes of older pacts. Evolution refuses to resonate deep within the bloodline; a deeper link cannot be established.
message.ssc_addon.evolution.fail.both: The foundation is too shallow, and the cursed rain has not fallen. In this double barrenness, the seedling of evolution has withered irretrievably.
message.ssc_addon.evolution.fail.already: Your attempt to establish a deeper link with the moonlight triggered a fatal resonance. Your form rejected evolution and returned the power of the curse—in the violent backlash, you became a brief, shrill echo under this cursed moon.
message.ssc_addon.evolution.fail.branche: The branches of your current evolution path have not all awakened. Unlock every branch of this path before using an Evolution Stone or Moon Marrow Cross Ring to evolve further.

codex.form.my_addon.snow_fox_sp.title:
'When the curse merges completely with the arctic storm, you are no longer just a snow fox...
You are the embodiment of the North, master of the blizzard'
codex.form.my_addon.snow_fox_sp.appearan: Your fur is as white as eternal snow, and your eyes glimmer with piercing cold light. Where you walk, the air condenses into frost. Your body radiates a chill that not even the hottest summer can dispel.
codex.form.my_addon.snow_fox_sp.pros:
Frost Spirit
You command the power of extreme cold to strike your enemies:

Snow Spike Dash: Consumes Frost, dash instantly towards your crosshair, dealing high physical damage with kinetic frost energy and inflicting Frost Freeze (greatly reducing speed/attack speed and increasing damage taken). You are immune to damage while dashing.

Teleport Attack: Use the cover of snow to teleport behind multiple enemies for a surprise attack. Deals increased damage to frozen targets. You are immune to damage during the attack.

Frost Ball: Launch a gravity-defying magic ice ball that inflicts Frost Fall, slowing enemies down.

Frost Storm: Channel power to summon a local frost storm. The storm continuously pulls in surrounding enemies and inflicts physical cutting damage with countless sharp icicles.

Frost Shield: when taking significant damage with frost energy at 20 or above, automatically consume 20 frost to reduce that hit by 50%.

Additionally, you retain the traits of a snow fox and are completely immune to cold.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Your damage is multiplied by 1.5.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
A successful native frost skill hit briefly reduces collapse growth for your next ice spell. Defaults: 15% reduction within 3 seconds. Further hits refresh the window without stacking. Consumed when ice casting starts; interruption does not refund it.
codex.form.my_addon.snow_fox_sp.cons:
Great ice power comes at a cost:

All active skills consume 'Frost'.

When Frost is depleted, you cannot cast skills and may become vulnerable.

You need to manage your energy wisely or equip a Blizzard Tank to assist in combat.
codex.form.my_addon.snow_fox_sp.instinct:
You crave the cold and detest the heat.
You may feel uncomfortable in high-temperature environments.
You have a natural affinity for snowballs and snow blocks, and the Blizzard Tank can be of great assistance.
origin.my_addon.form_snow_fox_sp.name: SP Snow Fox
origin.my_addon.form_snow_fox_sp.descrip: The sublimated form of a snow fox under the power of the Evolution Stone, controlling extreme cold magic and physical power.
codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_sp.title:
'When the curse merges completely with the essence of water, you are no longer just an Axolotl...
You are the controller of the abyss, master of the vortex'
codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_sp.appearanc: Your body becomes more transparent, shimmering with faint water light. Your skin seems to merge with the surrounding moisture, creating ripple-like waves with every move.
codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_sp.pros:
Abyssal Overlord
Your control over water elements has reached a new height, granting powerful water skills:

Water Spear Crafting: Use arrows and moisture to condense a temporary Water Spear. Melee range and damage equal to a Trident; inflicts Slowness on hit.

Vortex Impact: Press primary once to start charging, press again to release early, or wait 4s for automatic release. Pulls nearby enemies and deals up to 16 damage, launching them and applying Slowness III. Reduces incoming damage by 50% while charging. A default full charge costs up to 60 moisture, or 36 with Water Magic Efficiency.

Play Dead: Actively enter Play Dead state, removing all mob aggro, rapidly regenerating health, and greatly reducing damage taken.

Rain Hydration: Restore moisture in rain.

Rapid Metabolism: Natural regeneration speed increased by 20%.

Additionally, you retain all previous abilities: Water Breathing, Underwater Vision, Increased Swim Speed, etc.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Enemies being pulled during Vortex charging deal no attack damage to you. Damage returns after release, cancellation, or leaving the pull area. Creatures immune to pulling are unaffected.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Healing spells restore 50% more health for 10 Moisture per cast, plus 5 for each other whitelisted individual affected. Insufficient Moisture gives ordinary healing without this fee. Does not amplify reversed damage, cleansing, shields or durations.
codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_sp.cons:
Powerful water abilities require moisture to maintain:

Water Spear and Vortex Impact consume moisture (Play Dead does not).

Movement speed is still slow on land.

You still cannot wear helmets.

As a carnivore, you can only eat meat.
codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_sp.instincts:
Your perception of water elements has peaked, but your body has become more dependent on water. You can sense distant water bodies and always crave to return to the water.
Even on land, rain brings you solace.
origin.my_addon.form_anubis_wolf_sp.name: Netherjudge
origin.my_addon.form_anubis_wolf_sp.desc: A special variant of the Anubis Wolf. The undead essence has been further sublimated under the power of the Moon Essence Cross.
codex.form.my_addon.anubis_wolf_sp.title:
'When the curse merges completely with the undead essence under the Moon Essence Cross,
you are no longer merely the leader of the pack...
You are the arbiter of souls, the Netherjudge of the realm of the dead'
codex.form.my_addon.anubis_wolf_sp.appea: The resonance of the Moon Essence Cross has awakened deeper undead power within you. Your quadrupedal form has grown more imposing, with faint spectral light glimmering through the golden tufts along your cheeks. Your eyes burn with the flame of judgment, and soul sand whispers beneath your paws. You are no longer merely the alpha of the pack — you are the arbiter of the netherworld.
codex.form.my_addon.anubis_wolf_sp.pros:
Power of the Netherjudge
The curse of the Moon Essence Cross has fully merged with the undead power within you, granting you the authority to judge beyond the pack:

Soul Scrutiny: Your eyes can perceive the aura of death. Living creatures within 16 blocks whose health drops below 20% will glow in your vision and emit soul particles, leaving them nowhere to hide.

Death Sentence: Damage dealt to targets below 30% health is increased by 20%. Dying prey cannot escape judgment.

Wither Hunt: When creatures afflicted with Wither exist within 24 blocks, gain 20% movement speed boost outside of soul sand areas. The scent of wither drives the arbiter to accelerate the pursuit.

Death Domain: After 2 seconds of channeling, temporarily turns all blocks within a 24-block radius cylinder into soul sand. Hostile creatures within the domain suffer Slowness I, Wither I, and a 15% max health reduction. The domain lasts 15 seconds.

Netherwolf Tribunal: After howling for 1.5 seconds, summon Netherwolf minions. Netherwolves inflict Wither on attack, and attacking withered targets heals the caster. When Death Domain is active, summon count is doubled and Netherwolves gain enhanced attributes.

Undead Neutral: As the embodiment of undead power, undead creatures no longer attack you unless you strike first. Neutrality is restored 30 seconds after you stop attacking.

Soul Sand Recovery: Standing on soul sand or soul soil allows the energy of the netherworld to slowly restore your health.

Additionally, you inherit all instincts of the Anubis Wolf Evo III: Soul Speed III, Undead Undying, Wither spread attack & lifesteal, instant kill on withered targets below 5 hearts, Instant Damage heals you, eating Bones, immunity to Hunger & Poison, increased Rotten Flesh saturation, further reduced damage from undead creatures. Skeletons will flee from you.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
You deal 20% extra damage to enemies inside your domain. Enemies deal 50% less damage to you, your summons, and your pets.
codex.form.my_addon.anubis_wolf_sp.cons:
The cost of undead constitution still follows you:

When attacked, the surging undead power causes you to suffer Wither.
You cannot naturally regenerate; Regeneration potions have no effect, and health recovery from saturation is extremely slow.
Meat dropped from killed creatures rots into Rotten Flesh, and harvested crops may turn to dust.
Vegetarian food provides no saturation.
Your direct damage to undead creatures is reduced.

Ordinary leggings and boots no longer fit your quadrupedal body.
codex.form.my_addon.anubis_wolf_sp.insti:
The power of the Moon Essence Cross whispers of judgment and arbitration deep within your soul. You feel a sense of duty driving you to patrol the borders of the netherworld, judging all souls that transgress between life and death.
The soul sand beneath your feet is your throne, and the undead are your subjects. You are the Netherjudge, and the scales of souls rest in your hands.
message.ssc_addon.inhibitor.fail.sp_form: The inhibitor cannot revert this form
power.my_addon.true_invisibility.name: True Invisibility
power.my_addon.true_invisibility.descrip:
Press to enter true invisibility state, undetectable by any creature. Attacking, mining, or using items breaks invisibility (glass shatter sound). Press again to cancel (cat hiss sound). Any exit triggers a 12s Cooldown.

Starting a spell while invisible from the primary skill retains that specific invisibility until the spell releases or is interrupted, even beyond its original duration. Works with spellbooks, standalone scrolls and blueprints; ink invisibility is excluded. Manual cancellation, purification, death and form changes still end invisibility normally. Existing skills, Perks and accessories remain.
power.my_addon.true_invisibility_dash.de: While invisible, press the secondary key to break concealment and dash 5 blocks forward. 1 second after the dash, stuns enemies within a 5-block radius for 5s. Stunned enemies cannot move, attack, use items or turn the camera. Other wild cats are immune to the stun.
power.my_addon.wild_cat_sp_night_strengt: All damage dealt increased by 1 at night.
power.my_addon.wild_cat_sp_diet.name: Feral Diet
power.my_addon.wild_cat_sp_diet.descript: Hunger restored by raw food increased by 100%.
power.my_addon.wild_cat_sp_ink_blind.des: Right-click while holding an Ink Sac in main hand to consume one and inflict Blindness for 3s on mobs within a 9-block diameter. 4s cooldown.
origin.my_addon.form_wild_cat_sp.name: Wild Cat (SP)
origin.my_addon.form_wild_cat_sp.descrip: A special variant form of the wild cat.
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_sp.title:
'When power of the wild awakens completely, you are no longer just a wild cat...
You are the ghost of the jungle, the hunter of the night'
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_sp.appearan: Your body looks no different from a normal feral cat, but your eyes gleam with a more dangerous light, and your fur shimmers mysteriously under the moonlight.
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_sp.pros:
Moonlight Phantom
True Invisibility: You can actively enter complete invisibility. Attacking or using items breaks it. While invisible, you can use 'Stun Dash' or 'Weakness Spotting'.

Ink Blindness: Right-click with Ink Sac to blind nearby creatures momentarily, aiding escape or offense.

Night Walker: When night falls, your body becomes light, significantly increasing movement speed, letting you glide through the dark like a phantom.

Power of the Night: At night, your attacks become more deadly, dealing increased damage.

Feral Diet: Your digestive system returns to the primitive state; eating raw meat (like raw beef, raw porkchop, etc.) grants double food and saturation.

Additionally, you retain all feral cat instincts:
Silent Steps, Creeper Deterrent, No Fall Damage, Phantom Scare.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Primary-skill immobilization lasts 10 seconds. Affected targets take twice the damage from all sources until that immobilization ends or expires.

Veiled Casting: Starting a spell while invisible from the primary skill retains that specific invisibility until the spell releases or is interrupted, even beyond its original duration. Works with spellbooks, standalone scrolls and blueprints; ink invisibility is excluded. Manual cancellation, purification, death and form changes still end invisibility normally. Existing skills, Perks and accessories remain.
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_sp.cons:
Price of the Wild:

Nocturnal Habit: Your power is tied to moonlight — you thrive when night falls, and merely return to normal by day.

Equipment Limit: You cannot wear leggings or boots as they hinder your agility.
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_sp.instinct: Your wild instincts have reached their peak, but your soul has also been eroded by the Moon Curse. You feel a stronger connection to the jungle, always yearning to hunt in the darkness.

evolution.my_addon.familiar_fox.node.man: The mana system awakens within you. You now possess an independent mana reserve (max 33, regenerating 1 per second after 5s out of combat (paused in combat)); right-clicking creatures drains energy by type, restoring hunger and mana. When mana is plentiful (>50%), overflowing spiritual energy shields you from 15% damage; conversely, depleted mana leaves you weak.
evolution.my_addon.familiar_fox.node.spa: You have grasped a weakened fire ring — Spark. It costs 11 mana, erupts in a 3×3×3 area ahead, dealing 4 true damage and igniting non-whitelisted creatures. It is the seed of the full Fire Ring, to be replaced once you master it.
evolution.my_addon.familiar_fox.node.roc: Rocketry is unlocked. Holding arrows and spending mana lets you loose burning rockets; it also unlocks the Charm Paper Fireball — an explosive, high-damage fireball dealing up to 9 damage. This matches the original familiar's ranged arsenal.
evolution.my_addon.familiar_fox.node.buf: Your spiritual husk is now immune to a wide array of vanilla and mod status effects (poison, nausea, speed, wither, etc.), and has gained fire and lava immunity — standing in flames steadily drains mana to sustain this ward. Moreover, Looting III lets you reap more spoils from kills.
evolution.my_addon.familiar_fox.node.alc: The art of alchemy is yours. You may brew healing, harming and poison potions at a brewing stand; meanwhile, your mana cap rises by 10, housing more spiritual energy.
evolution.my_addon.familiar_fox.node.spi: Spirit Vision is active. Your eyes pierce the veil, causing nearby creatures to glow cyan and betray their presence. Mana cap rises by 10, and your automatic mana recovery rate quickens by 10%.
evolution.my_addon.familiar_fox.node.fir: The Fire Ring is mastered. It costs 11 mana, erupts around you dealing 8 damage and igniting non-whitelisted creatures for 10 seconds, identical to the original familiar. codex.form.my_addon.familiar_fox_red.pro:
Spirit Realm Lord
The magic within you has sublimated into a higher form, granting you unparalleled power:

Blue Fire Ring: You can activate a Blue Fire Ring around you. It continuously consumes mana to damage and inflict severe burning on nearby enemies. While active, your Soul Reaping ability is greatly enhanced.

Fox Fireball: spend mana to hurl a soul fox-fire projectile — piercing enemies in the first 12 blocks (8 magic damage), exploding on impact (6 physical damage, 6-block radius decaying with distance) and chaining to nearby enemies (4 damage), plus a cone of fire sparks at launch.

Soul Reaping: As a spiritual entity, you can draw power from fading lives. Killing targets restores a large amount of mana. If the Blue Fire Ring is active, kills also restore health and energy.

Mana Absorption: drain life essence from creatures for energy and satiation — normal creatures and humans give back generously, hostile creatures return a little along with debuffs. You slowly siphon the Cursed Moon's residual energy from the air. You can also slowly gather residual energy from the previous Cursed Moon from the atmosphere.

Spirit Embodiment: You are no longer mere flesh and blood, but a hybrid of flesh and mana. Thus, you are immune to more status effects, good or bad. With enhanced control over spiritual energy, when your mana is sufficient (Mana above 50), overflowing mana forms a shield around you that persistently reduces damage by 50%.

Additionally, you retain all previous abilities: you can see through creatures and move freely through sweet berry bushes.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Pay 10 Mana per cast to shorten preparation by 25%, with 5% more collapse growth. Uninterruptible phases and animations retain their original speed. Insufficient Mana uses ordinary timing and collapse cost.
codex.form.my_addon.familiar_fox_red.con:
Great power requires a huge price to maintain:

As a high-ranking spirit, your dependence on mana is more severe. Low or exhausted mana makes you weak and increases damage taken.

Your physical structure remains fragile, but you can endure slightly more damage than a normal familiar.
You cannot equip leggings or boots, and move slowly in water.
You gain less saturation from food.
origin.my_addon.form_familiar_fox_mancia: A forbidden Pillager weapon forged from a familiar vessel.
codex.form.my_addon.familiar_fox_mancian:
‘Mancianima is not a blessing from a god, but an answer torn from a god's corpse...
With Evolution Stone and soul-welding rites, witches forged a familiar into the Pillager faction's quietest and most costly forbidden weapon’

It still keeps the outline of a familiar, but its fur, eyes, and spiritual pressure feel recalibrated by Spirit Realm crystal. Its movements are calm and exact, like a living weapon finally awakened after countless stabilization rites.

Forbidden Weapon
Mancianima is not a naturally evolved spirit. Witches reverse-engineered the corpse of a Spirit Realm Lord, then forcibly stabilized a familiar vessel into an advanced weapon. The Evolution Stone floods your body with mana, granting cold, precise, and lethal combat instincts:

Mancianima Brand (Primary): Sustained aim performs weapon calibration on a creature, first applying a yellow brand and then escalating it to a red brand. Killing a target during the brand window primes your pursuit system again

Soulleap (Secondary): Spend mana for a short-range teleport. Two modes are configurable: RAYCAST for instant blink and PLATFORM for landing-pad lock-on. Killing a target locked by Mancianima Brand resets teleport cooldown and refills your damage-resist buffer

Mana Drain: Recover mana from kills and slowly absorb residual Cursed Moon energy from the air

Bell Assault: ring a bell in a village to trigger the Mancianima Assault — 10 seconds later a raider squad (pillagers and vindicators, occasionally evokers, witches or even a ravager) marches in from your facing direction, and nearby iron golems turn on you; an independent boss bar tracks the remaining villagers, and clearing them all drops rewards (2 emerald blocks and 1 totem of undying). 1 MC-day cooldown (only counted after a successful assault; walking away or logging off aborts it without consuming the cooldown). Nearby iron golems turn against you, and a dedicated Villagers Remaining boss bar appears; clearing every villager in range grants rewards (1 MC-day cooldown)

Villager Plunder: You cannot trade with villagers or wandering traders, but killing them plunders goods based on their trades and has an extra 30% chance to drop 1-3 emeralds

Villager Flee: Nearby villagers and wandering traders instinctively flee from you and are slowed

Damage-Block System: you innately hold 2 charges of damage block, each fully negating one creature attack with a brief invulnerability window; after 15 seconds without taking any damage you regain 1 charge every 15s. A successful red-mark execute refills both charges and cooldowns.

Weapon Instinct: you cannot attack raid-faction creatures; bare-handed attacks deal a fixed 2 true damage, weapon attacks deal 20% less damage.

You also retain the familiar's baseline gifts: free passage through sweet berry bushes, a small frame, and agile movement

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
The primary skill's damage calculation cap rises to 40. The primary-secondary combo cap doubles to 74 by default. Fixed damage from bare-hand attacks and villager draining doubles.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Projectile spells home onto a visible enemy within 15 degrees of the crosshair and the spell's maximum range, prioritizing the smallest angle. Costs 10 Mana per cast; a valid lock with insufficient Mana prevents casting. With no valid target, fire straight without this Mana fee. Projectiles expire at their maximum travel distance.

Forced stabilization is not gentle:

All active abilities draw on mana. Without enough mana, you cannot teleport and Mancianima Brand escalates more slowly

The Evolution Stone's power is not a natural flow, but high-pressure spiritual energy forced into your body by stabilization rites; you must keep your combat loop alive through killing and draining

Pillager weapon instincts are carved into you. You cannot trade with villagers or wandering traders; they will flee from you and become targets for plunder

Bell Assault aggroes nearby iron golems and locks you out for 1 MC-day, making it dangerous for players who need to live near villages

Your body is still based on a familiar's frame: you cannot equip leggings or boots, and you move sluggishly in water

Food gives less satiety, so ordinary meals alone struggle to sustain this modified soul-vessel
The echo of the stabilization rites remains nailed into your soul: obey, lock on, pursue, clear the field. If no master is present, the weapon will find its own next command.

Your eyes gleam with a cold light, and an oppressive aura permeates the air around you. Your existence is no longer a gentle melody—but a screech that makes all things tremble.
codex.form.my_addon.fallen_allay_sp.pros:
Spirit of the Fallen
You have embraced the dark side of the curse:

Summon Vex: Summon two loyal vexes to fight for you. They prioritize marked targets and hostile players, lasting 35 seconds. 20s cooldown after all vexes die.

Shadow Screech: Charge for 1s to unleash a soul screech, highlighting all non-friendly entities within 25 blocks for 8s (visible to all), while destroying all projectiles in range. 20s cooldown.

Hatred Mark: When attacking or being attacked, the target/attacker glows for 10s. Vexes prioritize marked targets.

Shadow Blade: while holding an iron-tier or better weapon, your melee attack damage is increased by 2 points.

Fire Spirit Body: as a fallen spirit, you are completely immune to fire damage.

Raid Ally: Raid faction mobs see you as a companion and won't attack you. You cannot harm them either. Your vexes also won't attack raid mobs.

Levitation Flight: You retain the Allay's flight ability, floating with the jump key.

Silent Steps: Your footsteps make no sound, you can walk on powder snow, and you're immune to fall damage.



Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
You and your summons deal 1.5 times damage. Secondary-skill Glowing lasts 16 seconds. While marked, targets deal 25% less damage to you and take 25% more damage from you, stacking with the 1.5 multiplier.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
A direct curse hit copies its effect to the nearest visible unprotected enemy within 5 blocks of the original target. Includes Curse Mark and Dread Whisper. At most one extra target per cast; no recursive chains or original-target duplication. Self-centered persistent effects such as Corrupt Mist do not trigger it. After a successful chain, pay 15% of this cast's actual collapse cost once. Existing curse duration, curse refunds, native abilities, Perks and accessories remain.
codex.form.my_addon.fallen_allay_sp.cons:
Price of the Fallen:

Slow Mining: Your mining speed is reduced, even more so while flying.

Carnivore: You can only eat cooked meats. Other food is inedible to you.

Equipment Limitation: You cannot equip leggings or boots.

codex.form.my_addon.fallen_allay_sp.inst: An endless screech echoes in the depths of your soul. You crave battle, crave the hunt—your vexes are extensions of your will, and each summoning deepens your bond with the shadows. You no longer need the gentle glow of amethyst; instead, you savor the aroma of cooked meat and the warmth of flames. Villagers flee in terror at your sight, while pillagers see you as a trusted companion. You know there's no going back—but you have no regrets.

You are the embodiment of melody, master of crystal sound'
codex.form.my_addon.allay_sp.appearance: Your body emits a pale blue glow, wings gently beating the air as you float in mid-air. Your very existence is a silent symphony.
codex.form.my_addon.allay_sp.pros:
Crystal Sound
You command the resonant power of amethyst:

Mass Purification: Charge for 1.5s to purify all potion effects from entities in a large radius and interrupt other SP forms' active skills.

Group Heal: Charge for 3s, consume all mana, heal all living beings in a large area for 75% of their max health, grant absorption hearts equal to 50% of their max health (30s) and Resistance I for 10s. If no other healable player is in range, you gain Strength II, Resistance II for 20s and 30% ranged damage up for 20s. Being hit while charging interrupts it, only granting brief Resistance and Speed.

Totem Guard: right-click to activate a Totem of Undying in your inventory; when an ally (or yourself) within 20 blocks takes fatal damage, the totem is consumed to prevent death, granting brief absorption, regeneration and fire resistance. Activations are 20 seconds apart; you may hold only one active guardian totem at a time; an active totem loses its power the moment it leaves your inventory (dropped, stored or given away)

Portable Beacon: right-click a held beacon to toggle it. It remains active in your own inventory, costs 1 energy every 3 seconds, and grants Haste II to you and whitelisted units within a 20-block radius. Passive energy regeneration pauses while active. It turns off when energy runs out or the beacon leaves your inventory.

Emergency Food: when hunger is empty and energy is at 50+, automatically consumes 50 energy to restore 1 hunger point

Crystal Ward: Normal single-hit damage cannot exceed 25% of your maximum health.

Trade Discount: Due to your cute appearance, you get a Hero of the Village II discount when trading with villagers.

Levitation Flight: You can float in the air by pressing the jump key, but it consumes hunger.

Amethyst Food: you can only eat amethyst shards to restore hunger; eating one resonates with your body, applying Regeneration II to nearby entities with resonance particles.

Ranged Enhancement: Your ranged attack damage is greatly increased, and ranged hits restore 8% mana and half a heart every 3.5s.

Hit Recovery: You can recover health when dealing enough damage.

Creature Sensing: You can see glowing outlines of nearby creatures.

Jukebox Healing: You slowly recover health near a playing jukebox.

Powder Snow Walking: You can walk on powder snow without sinking.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Group Purification also applies Weakness II and Slowness I for 15 seconds.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Each wounded player restores at least 0.25 health per hit, capped at maximum health. Share 25% of actual enemy health lost to your spells equally as healing among wounded whitelisted players within 16 blocks of you, including yourself. Full-health players take no share; pets, summons, self/ally damage, absorption and overkill do not contribute. After actual healing, pay 15% of this cast's actual collapse cost once per cast. Existing lunar cooldown, summoning affinity, native abilities, Perks and accessories remain.

origin.my_addon.form_golden_sandstorm_sp: The special variant form of the Jackal. The essence of wither has been elevated to the extreme under the power of the golden sandstorm.
'When the curse merges completely with the golden sandstorm, you are no longer merely a jackal of the desert...
You are the echo of the wasteland, the embodiment of eroding sand'

Golden dust and withering breath coil around your body. Your fur carries a dark golden sheen like dunes at sunset, and every step seems to leave traces of soul sand behind. In your eyes, an endless sandstorm keeps turning.

Golden Sandstorm
The essence of wither has been pushed to its limit within the golden sandstorm, granting you powers of erosion and retaliation:

Wither Sand: Charge for 1s to unleash a 15-block golden sandstorm, inflicting Sand Blind for 3s on non-whitelisted entities and adding 1 Erosion Brand stack. Movement speed is reduced by 50% while charging. Taking damage interrupts the charge and triggers a 7s cooldown; a successful release triggers a 26s cooldown.

Erosion Brand: Melee attacks stack Erosion Brand on the target, up to 3 stacks, lasting 10s. By default, the same target can gain at most 1 stack per second. Attacking again at 3 stacks triggers a passive burst, dealing 20% of the target's current health as damage (cap 20) and healing you for 10% of your max health. The target then enters a green cooldown state and cannot be stacked again for a short time.

Detonate Brand: Detonate all non-green Erosion Brands, dealing 20% of each target's current health as damage (cap 20) and healing you for 20% of your missing health. Targets at 3 stacks trigger a passive burst before detonation.

Brand Perception: Erosion-branded entities glow in different colors based on brand level: yellow, orange, and red. Green indicates stack cooldown.

Counter Burst: When hit, automatically retaliate, knocking back non-whitelisted entities within 4 blocks and applying Wither I for 5s.

Wither Adaptation: You are immune to Wither, Blindness, and Sand Blind.

Additionally, you inherit most undead instincts of Anubis Wolf Evo III: Soul Speed, Undead Undying, bone eating, Hunger and Poison immunity, increased Rotten Flesh saturation, Instant Damage healing, reduced damage from undead creatures, and skeleton intimidation.

The golden sandstorm cannot erase the cost of undead constitution:

Starved Vitality: You can no longer regenerate naturally from saturation, and Regeneration potions have no effect on you. Your health can only be restored through Wither erosion, kills, and the passive cycle below:
　· Each time your applied Wither damages an enemy → +0.5 heart
　· Personal kill of an enemy → +2 hearts
　· Kill by your summoned Netherwolf → +1.5 hearts
　Passive cycle: out of combat → +0.5 heart every 10s; in combat → +0.5 heart every 6s

Meat dropped from killed creatures rots into Rotten Flesh, and harvested crops may turn to dust.

Vegetarian food provides no saturation, and your direct damage to undead creatures is reduced.

Ordinary leggings and boots still do not fit your quadrupedal body.

Wither Sand requires charging and is interrupted by damage; Erosion Brand also needs sustained pressure on a target to reach its full potential.

You hear grains of sand grinding deep within your soul, like the whispers of countless dead. You crave seeing enemies branded, swallowed by windblown sand, and slowly eroded by wither.
Each retaliation feels like the sandstorm answering your anger. Each detonation feels like the desert reclaiming prey it marked long ago.

codex.form.my_addon.bat_desmodus.appeara: Your body has been reforged by the Moon Essence Cross’s curse. codex.form.my_addon.bat_desmodus.pros:
Bloodthirster
The curse of the Moon Essence Cross grants you power far beyond an ordinary bat:

Mist Form: Press the active skill key to dissolve into a cloud of mist, your model fading away. While in mist, you are immune to all damage except the void, lasting about 4.5 seconds. After 1 second in mist, press again to charge a Burst, dealing 12 damage and knockback to enemies within 4 blocks. Cooldown 10 seconds. At blood thirst ≥75, the mist itself turns lethal: 2 damage per second to enemies within 2 blocks, healing you

Sonic Burst: Release a 3.5-block-wide, 8-block-long ultrasonic wave forward, dealing 6 physical damage to non-whitelisted creatures and inflicting Nausea for 3s. Player targets are also Deafened for 3s; non-player targets gain Blindness for 3s. Cooldown 8 seconds

Bloodthirst Instinct: As a vampire, combat continuously builds your blood thirst — landing attacks, hitting with skills, and killing enemies all add up. Below 25 thirst you gain 15% damage reduction; at 50 or above you gain 30% lifesteal; at 75+ damage is increased by 15% and lifesteal rises to 52.5%. After 12 seconds out of combat, the value begins to decay

Moonlit Frenzy: At night under open sky, moonlight awakens your predator instincts: +15% attack damage, +5% movement speed, and out-of-combat blood thirst decay is halved

Echolocation: Activates automatically once night falls (indoor or outdoor). Every 3 seconds, all living entities within 12 blocks gain a 1-second Glowing pulse on a continuous loop, letting you track every target through the dark

In addition, you retain nearly all the abilities of an ordinary bat: gliding and slow falling, night vision, wall-clinging, aerial acceleration, jump enhancement, fast bare-hand digging, sonar hearing, and the ability to mine diamonds while holding the Mosaic Claw

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Skill damage doubles, including Mist Form bursts and blood mist damage.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
If at least 15 Blood is available when casting starts, automatically pay 15 Blood to reduce this cast's collapse growth by 35%. Otherwise cast normally without this fee. Pay once per cast; interruption does not refund it. Existing blood feedback, Lunar Mend bonus, native abilities, Perks and accessories remain.
codex.form.my_addon.bat_desmodus.cons:
The Price of Bloodlust:

Sunlight Frailty: Under open sky during the day, your vampiric nature falters: -20% attack damage, -10% movement speed, and out-of-combat blood thirst decay is accelerated by 50%. Removed instantly when in shade, underwater, or beneath a block

Bloodbane Iron: Vampiric blood is acutely vulnerable to refined iron — when struck by an attacker wielding an iron weapon (sword/axe/pickaxe/shovel/hoe), incoming damage is increased by an additional 15%

Your body is still that of a small bat: you cannot equip chestplates, leggings, or boots, and cannot use ranged weapons

Walking on the ground slows you down — the sky is your true domain
codex.form.my_addon.bat_desmodus.instinc: The lure of blood calls to you at every moment. Each time night falls and moonlight pierces the clouds, your instincts surge to life — you hear every heartbeat, smell every trace of blood, and crave the bite and the feast. When the sun rises, you want only to hide in the deepest shadow, curling up to wait for night to return. You no longer belong to the world of light.

power.my_addon.form_bat_parasitic_fruit_: Launch a spiritfruit seed toward your crosshair. On hitting a creature, the seed attaches to the host, roots for about 1 second, then bears fruit every 1.25 seconds: allied hosts are dynamically granted healing, absorption, Swiftness or Haste depending on combat state and health; hostile hosts grow Vine, Bitter, Rotten, or Sour Fruit, applying Slowness, Weakness, Glowing, Poison, etc. While a hostile host is parasitized by a debuff fruit, all healing that target receives is reduced by 50%. Fruits affect only the directly hit host. 1s cooldown, costs 1 Seed Charge; missing a creature triggers a half cooldown without consuming a charge. Harmful status effects applied to unprotected non-player creatures gain one level.
advancements.my_addon.on_transform_bat_p: Transform into Parasitic Fruit Bat for the first time
‘When the Evolution Stone presses the vitality of fruit and echo into a bat’s wing bones, it is no longer merely a shadow in the night...
You become the sower of a moving orchard, making seeds bloom inside allies and enemies alike.’

Your wings keep the outline of an ordinary bat, but green and golden veins faintly flow beneath the membrane. Tiny spiritfruit seeds drift around you like fireflies, waiting to be planted into the next host.

Moving Orchard
The Evolution Stone mutates the bat’s fruit-eating instinct into a parasitic support gift:

Parasitic Spiritfruit: Press the primary active key to launch a spiritfruit seed toward your crosshair. The seed must hit a creature. Once attached, it roots for about 1 second and then bears fruit every 1.25 seconds. If the host is allied, it dynamically grants healing, absorption, Swiftness, or Haste depending on combat state and health. If the host is hostile, it grows Vine, Bitter, Rotten, or Sour Fruit, inflicting Slowness, Weakness, Glowing, Poison, and similar debuffs

Parasitic Limit: You can maintain up to 3 spiritfruit seeds at once. A single target can carry up to 3 stacked seeds; hitting it again adds a stack and refreshes the duration

You also retain most traits of a Permanent-Phase Bat: small body, night vision, slow falling, wall clinging, aerial acceleration, enhanced jumping, fast bare-hand digging, and fruit instinct.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Harmful status effects you apply gain one level, retaining their duration. Allied buffs retain their original levels.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Non-red spells carrying harmful status effects cost 25% more collapse and make those effects contagious. Excludes burning, knockback, instant damage and buffs. Unprotected creatures become infected after continuously staying within a 3-block sphere of a carrier for more than 2.5 seconds; leaving resets exposure. Each carrier infects at most 2 others. Initial hits are generation 1; generation 3 cannot transmit. Copy only remaining duration; cleansing, death or effect expiry stops that carrier. No cyclic reinfection within a cast. Existing summoning affinity, seed sowing, native abilities, Perks and accessories remain.

This parasitic ecology is unstable:

Spiritfruit seeds must hit a creature to take effect. Missing only triggers a half cooldown

During daytime under open sky, seed duration is shortened; at night or in low light, seed duration is extended

Positive fruits planted on yourself have reduced duration, preventing support power from becoming pure self-buffing

Your body is still that of a tiny bat: you cannot equip chestplates, leggings, or boots, cannot use ranged weapons, and walking on the ground is slow.

You can hear the faint flow of moisture inside flesh, and smell different scents from wounds, fear, and fatigue. Your instinct no longer seeks only fruit — it seeks bodies suitable for seeds to root in. Allies are moving orchards. So are enemies.
power.my_addon.form_bat_parasitic_fruit_: Throw an exploding seed that detonates without dealing damage on hitting a block or creature, releasing spores. Within the 4-block explosion: whitelist-protected allies are healed continuously during the infection; other creatures are infected for 10 seconds—taking poison-rhythm periodic damage (about 1 HP every 1.25 seconds), unable to heal from food saturation, and all damage they deal is reduced by 15%. Non-whitelisted creatures within 1.5 blocks of an infected target are infected as well, inheriting the remaining duration of the current source. On landing it also leaves a 4-block-diameter poison fog cloud lasting 10 seconds: non-whitelisted creatures entering it are infected for the cloud's remaining time (already-infected creatures are not re-infected), while allies entering receive healing spores; the Allay's Purify clears the infection and dissipates the cloud. 1s cooldown, costs 1 Seed Charge. Poison applied to unprotected non-player creatures gains one level.

'The light of the Evolution Stone awakened the dormant fluorescent genes of the axolotl...
You are no longer the tyrant of the abyss, but a fluorescent spirit wandering between light and water'

The Evolution Stone's light flows beneath your damp skin, your gill clusters leaking a faint fluorescent glow. Your body is smaller and lighter than a common axolotl's, and every movement leaves a dim fluorescent trail in the water.

Spirit of Fluorescence
The Evolution Stone granted you a unique fluorescent constitution and control abilities:

Tidal Surge: manipulate the surrounding water into a tide, continuously pulling and dragging enemies in range (the base version deals no damage — control focused).

Array Laser: Charge the fluorescent energy within your body, then release a high-intensity array laser dealing massive magic damage to enemies in a straight line ahead.

Slime Membrane: Your skin is coated in a layer of fluorescent slime, granting a 20% chance to completely dodge physical attacks from enemies, both melee and ranged.

Mucous Fall Buffering: The fluorescent slime absorbs the impact of falling, rendering you immune to all fall damage.

Additionally, you retain the axolotl's aquatic traits: water breathing, aqua vision, swim speed boost, and a carnivorous diet.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Your damage is multiplied by 1.5.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Pay 10 Moisture per projectile spell for 50% more flight speed and maximum range, with 5% more collapse growth. Insufficient Moisture uses an ordinary projectile.

The power of fluorescence comes at the cost of fragility:

Your small frame actually holds slightly more life than a normal axolotl (max health +2, about one extra heart), though still far below larger forms.

Out of water you continuously lose moisture; once moisture is depleted, you suffer dehydration damage every second. You must frequently return to water or rely on rain to survive.

Your movement speed on land remains slow, and you cannot wear a helmet.

You have a dual longing for water and light. The fluorescent instinct drives you to always seek moist environments, while the Evolution Stone's energy gives you an indescribable affinity for glowing things in the dark. You feel yourself both a child of the water and a vessel of light—this dual nature lets you swim freely in the abyss while yearning to light up your fluorescence in the darkness.

codex.form.my_addon.upgrade_axolotl.appe: Your husk remains that of an axolotl, but the water channels within have been redirected. codex.form.my_addon.upgrade_axolotl.pros:
Independent Evolution
You have broken from the original axolotl's fixed evolution tree, customizing abilities via talent points. Each unlocked node awakens its power and dynamically appends a book-style narrative to the Appearance page:

Aquatic Adaptation / Water Propulsion / Water Burst / Thrown Water Spear / Vortex Guidance / Become Water

Additionally, you retain the axolotl's baseline gifts: underwater breathing, nimble swimming, moist skin, and a water-affined nature.
codex.form.my_addon.upgrade_axolotl.cons:
Independent evolution demands a higher growth threshold:

Active abilities are moisture-driven; prolonged time out of water leaves you parched and weak.

You must reach level 50 and unlock both branches before using the Moon Essence Cross / Evolution Stone for your final metamorphosis.

Your body remains axolotl-based: no helmet, accelerated moisture loss on land (1.5x), so mind the water source.
codex.form.my_addon.upgrade_axolotl.inst: You sense two distinct evolutionary potentials whispering within — one the abyssal surge of the Moon Essence Cross, the other the fluorescent echo of the Evolution Stone. Both await your final choice after completing your talent path.

codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_aling.title:
'Every tide of the sea remembers her name.
You are no longer the girl the moonlight changed, but the last guardian spirit of Azure Harbor—
The tide that never fully recedes, the homeland you can never return to.'
codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_aling.appear: Your form is as lithe as a Fluorescent Axolotl's, yet cloaked in a softer glow—as if steeped in the harbor's moonlight and polished by endless tides. A pale golden light seeps from your crimson gill clusters, and every swim leaves a long fluorescent trail behind you, like the lantern-wake of a fishing boat. The small pendant ground from a sea-crystal shard at your neck is the sole keepsake of the girl you once were.
codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_aling.pros:
Guardian Spirit of Azure Harbor
You bear the full power of the Fluorescent Axolotl, deepened by your pact with the bay:

Tidal Surge: manipulate the surrounding water into a tide, continuously pulling and dragging enemies in range. As a guardian spirit your tidal power runs deeper—the tidal orb's flight and tether duration are extended by 20%, and it deals continuous damage to tethered enemies.

Array Laser: innately uses the enhanced triple-shot version without any trinket — unfolds three arrays and fires three shortened lasers in a window (12 physical damage each), each stacking cooldown; movement speed -50% for the whole duration.

Tidewater's Favor: Your bond with the sea makes you lose moisture more slowly on land than a common Fluorescent Axolotl (about 25% slower).

Additionally, you retain the axolotl's aquatic traits: water breathing, aqua vision, swim speed boost, and a carnivorous diet.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Your damage is multiplied by 1.5, stacking with Aling's existing enhancements.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Pay 10 Moisture per projectile spell for 50% more flight speed and maximum range, with 5% more collapse growth. Insufficient Moisture uses an ordinary projectile.
codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_aling.cons:
The price of being a guardian spirit is that there is no going back:

Your small frame actually holds slightly more life than a normal axolotl (max health +2, about one extra heart), though still far below larger forms.

Out of water you still continuously lose moisture; once moisture is depleted, you suffer dehydration damage every second. You must frequently return to water or rely on rain to survive.

Your movement speed on land remains slow, and you cannot wear a helmet.
codex.form.my_addon.axolotl_aling.instin: You remember the nights of the great ebb, when the moon spread a trembling silver road across the entire sea; and that night when the sickly purple light fell upon the sea-stack, and the agony that burst from deep within your bones. The fishermen's dialect, your father's averted face, the coolness of the sea-crystal pendant—these memories that belong to no axolotl still surge in your blood. You are a child of the waves, a vessel of moonlight, and above all the girl who can never return to Tidefall Village. You guard this bay, for the sea remembers everyone willing to stay when the tide goes out.

origin.my_addon.form_ocelot_nova.descrip: An ocelot variant sharing the same origin as the Wind Spirit, yet walking an entirely different path. Renowned for feline nine-lives resilience and agility, it always finds a way out even in the direst straits.
advancements.my_addon.on_transform_ocelo: Transform into Nova for the first time
power.my_addon.form_ocelot_nova_nine_liv: A cat has nine lives. When struck down by lethal damage, automatically consume 1 life to revive on the spot: restore 6 health, gain 6 absorption hearts (30s) and 1 second of invulnerability; being struck down again within the next 3 seconds means true death. Max 8 lives; regenerate 1 life every 20 seconds while out of combat; after truly dying and respawning, lives refill to 8. You innately have a 15% base dodge (chance to fully ignore a hit).
power.my_addon.form_ocelot_nova_charge.d: Charge for 5 seconds then self-detonate, consuming 1 life: during charge you are slowed 70%, gain Resistance III (5s) and cannot sprint. Deals 50 lethal damage within 5 blocks, falling off with distance out to 12 blocks; does not break blocks and has no friendly fire. Cooldown 30s. Base damage is 100 at close range against unprotected non-player creatures, retaining distance falloff.
power.my_addon.form_ocelot_nova_leap.des: Dash toward your crosshair (usable in air), chainable twice with up to 5 seconds between leaps; each use grants +20% dodge (lasts 3s). Cooldown 10s; using it only once past the window gives a 6s cooldown. Dodge: a chance to fully ignore one melee or ranged hit — no damage, no knockback.
item.ssc_addon.wind_spirit_stamina_neckl: A claw bell woven from phantom membrane and feathers, letting the Wind Spirit's Gale Claws recover stamina faster after overheating (refill in ~5.5s).
item.ssc_addon.nova_revive_necklace.desc: A cat's-eye stone glowing with an undying totem's afterglow. Strengthens Nova's nine-lives revival: revive healing 6→8, invulnerability 1→1.8s, and knocks back and slows nearby foes on revival.
origin.my_addon.form_upgrade_axolotl.des: An independent evolution form based on the vanilla Axolotl, with abilities unlocked by evolution level.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.name: Upgrade Axolotl
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.axolotl_: Keeps the axolotl's base traits: cannot wear a helmet, carnivorous diet, axolotl sounds, water breathing. On land moisture drains at 1.5x (refillable with a humidifier); running out of moisture causes dehydration damage. An independent evolution line, split from the vanilla axolotl.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.aquatic_: Grants night vision underwater; greatly boosts swim speed; lets you leap out of the water near the surface.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.water_pr: Increases movement speed while sprinting on land; sprint-jumps gain extra forward burst and splash.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.water_sp: In water, press sprint to dash forward (free); on land, press sneak while sprinting to dash (costs moisture). 5s cooldown.

Primary skill. Leap back-and-up about 3 blocks, then freeze and aim for 1.35s (view rotation only), then throw a straight water spear toward your crosshair: 12 direct physical damage and 5 area damage within a 2-block radius at the impact point. Both deal 50% more to non-player enemies (18 / 7.5 damage), respecting the whitelist. The direct target does not also take area damage. Costs 6% moisture, 8s cooldown.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.vortex_g: Secondary skill. Channel for 3s, slowed by ~50% during the channel, healing 6 hearts total; on completion gain 2 extra golden hearts (absorption, 30s). Costs no moisture, 8s cooldown.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.become_w: Fully merge with water: land moisture drain returns to normal (removes the extra 1.5x drain).
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.branch_m: One of the SP evolution branches auto-unlocked at level 50. Evolve into the SP Axolotl with a Moon Marrow Ring under a Cursed Moon.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.branch_s: One of the SP evolution branches auto-unlocked at level 50. Evolve into the Fluorescent Axolotl with an Evolution Stone.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.aquatic_: Your body grows ever more suited to the water—your eyes see clearly beneath the surface, you swim like an arrow, and a mere touch of the surface lets you leap free.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.water_pr: The water surging within you becomes propulsive force: your strides quicken when sprinting on land, and your leaps carry a splash-wrapped burst of momentum.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.water_sp: You've learned to harness the current within—in water, press sprint to surge forward; on land, crouch (sneak) while sprinting to force out a burst of water that hurls you onward, at the cost of some moisture.

The art of shaping water into a spear is complete. Leap back and up, gather in midair, hold your breath for 1.35s, then hurl a straight water spear that pierces your target and erupts a 2-block splash. It costs 6% moisture and must wait 8 seconds before reuse.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.vortex_g: You can stir the water around you into a vortex, soothing your wounds with a 3-second channel—healing 6 hearts, and conjuring 2 golden hearts to shield you upon completion. You move slowly while channeling, yet it costs no moisture, on an 8-second cooldown.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.become_w: You have become one with water, no longer fearing to run dry. Your moisture drain on land returns to normal, and that extra 1.5x loss is dispelled.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.branch_m: The potential of the SP Axolotl has awakened within you. This is one of two SP evolution branches auto-unlocked at level 50—once you complete the transformation with a Moon Marrow Ring under a Cursed Moon, you may become the SP Axolotl.
evolution.my_addon.axolotl.node.branch_s: The potential of the Fluorescent Axolotl has awakened within you. This is one of two SP evolution branches auto-unlocked at level 50—once you complete the transformation with an Evolution Stone, you may become the Fluorescent Axolotl.

Steeped in the power of the Moon Essence Cross, the spider essence transmutes into an arcane Moon Weaver.
advancements.my_addon.on_transform_spide: Transform into Moon Weaver for the first time
codex.form.my_addon.spider_moon_weaver.t:
'When the power of the Moon Essence Cross seeps into the woven dark, the spider is no longer merely a lurking hunter...
You become the Moon Weaver that weaves arcane webs, every strand flowing with mana.'
codex.form.my_addon.spider_moon_weaver.a: Your body is reshaped by the curse of the Moon Essence Cross. Eight limbs glow with a faint arcane violet light, your compound eyes flicker with an eerie magic in the dark, and arcane runes drift across your cobweb-patterned carapace.
codex.form.my_addon.spider_moon_weaver.p:
Arcane Weaver
You inherit all the instincts and traits of the original spider:

Climbing: Climb any wall on contact, and move freely through cobwebs without slowing down

Spinning & Webbing (primary): hold to charge web shots (3 charge tiers) to trap prey or lay slowing webs; sneak double-tap the primary key to toggle Bridge/Attack mode — Bridge lays flat web bridges. Continuously consumes spider mana

Silk Swing (secondary): fire a silk strand to swing through the air (mana per block); hitting a creature tethers and drags it toward you

Arthropod Instinct: Classified as an arthropod; spiders and cave spiders no longer attack you, but iron golems are hostile

Web Artisan: Craft cobwebs from materials, regain mana by hitting cocooned enemies, and gather spider fluid cocoons as food

Auxiliary Forelimbs: Extra arms can hold auxiliary tools and shields

Night Vision & Immunity: Possess night vision, fully immune to poison

Web Affinity: standing on cobwebs or your own web membrane is home ground — +20% speed, +1 mana per second, -20% damage taken

Moon Venom: creatures within 8 blocks caught in your web or cocoon are continuously inflicted with Poison I

Cocoon Hunter: melee attacks against cocooned (fully immobilized) targets deal 15% more damage and restore spider mana

You also retain the spider's other traits: falling protection, auto-feeding, increased step height, and eating string to recover mana

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
You deal 25% extra damage to cocooned enemies. Enemies tethered by your secondary skill deal 40% less damage to you and take 15% more damage from you.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Projectile spells spend 8 web energy per cast: ground impacts leave a roughly 3x3 membrane patch lasting 60–90s; direct effective hits leave no web and have a 15% chance to fully cocoon the target (15s for mobs, 5s for players). Each cast rolls once per target; an unrefreshed curse mark still rolls. Piercing direct hits prevent later web placement. Protected targets are exempt. Insufficient energy casts normally without the bonus or fee. Existing lunar, venom, cocoon, Perk and accessory bonuses remain.
codex.form.my_addon.spider_moon_weaver.c:
The Price of the Arcane:

Your body is still that of a small spider: you cannot equip chestplates, leggings, or boots

Fire Frailty: As an arthropod, burn damage is increased

Your diet is reduced to spider fluid cocoons and string (other food is inedible)

Walking on the ground slows you down — your true domain is the walls and ceiling

power.my_addon.form_spider_moon_weaver_w: When you stand on or touch cobwebs and your own woven web membrane, your web domain awakens: +20% movement speed, +1 web mana per second, and 20% less damage taken.
power.my_addon.form_spider_moon_weaver_m: Enemies afflicted by your Web Bound or Cocooning status suffer continuous Moon Venom, afflicted with Poison I. Spiders and Allay-kin are immune.
power.my_addon.form_spider_moon_weaver_c: Melee attacks against targets you have cocooned (fully immobilized) deal 15% more damage. Synergizes with your instinct to regain web mana when striking cocooned foes. You deal 25% extra damage to unprotected cocooned non-player creatures, stacking with the existing bonus.
