A wild cat prowling the edge of dreams.
advancements.my_addon.on_transform_wild_: Transform into Nightmare for the first time
power.my_addon.form_wild_cat_nightmare_f: Cast terror upon those you have drawn into dreams: their vision is sealed within a 16-block pink fog sphere, their movement slowed by 20%, and a warden-like heartbeat pounds in their ears — faint while the Nightmare is beyond sight, rising louder as it closes in. While feared, their dream is locked in place; the first damage they take from a Nightmare or its whitelisted allies is doubled. Nightmares are fully invisible to them beyond 16 blocks; within range they flicker in a pulse of 2 seconds hidden and 0.6 seconds revealed, and each Nightmare strike reveals it for 1.5 seconds. Feared creatures cannot see the very Nightmare that cast the fear upon them — they hold no hatred toward it, rallying for a mere 2 seconds when struck by it before the hatred dissolves into mist. When the fear ends, they are forcibly awakened and cannot fall asleep again for 20 seconds. 20s cooldown.
power.my_addon.form_wild_cat_nightmare_s: Behind every dreaming enemy, a creeper's fuse begins to hiss — a phantom creeper only they can see, priming to burst harmlessly after 3 seconds. Should they turn and strike it, a ghostly wild cat bursts from the dispersing smoke, hisses low, leaps at their face and rakes them with a cruel blow (12 magic damage), then scatters into fireworks — and only they can see any of it. Against dreaming creatures, an unseen ghostly cat simply lunges and bites (12 magic damage), resetting their dream to a full 20 seconds. 8s cooldown.
power.my_addon.form_wild_cat_nightmare_d: You feed on the dreams of your prey: 15% of the damage you deal to dreaming targets is converted into your own health. If a target dies while dreaming, you devour its final lingering dream to restore 4 extra health.
power.my_addon.form_wild_cat_nightmare_p: Phantoms are creatures born from the nightmares of the sleepless — they regard you as kin of the dream's edge and will never choose you as prey, retreating even when struck by your claws.
power.my_addon.form_wild_cat_nightmare_c: You were born of the Cursed Moon's magic and resonate with it: on cursed moon nights, the accumulated damage needed to pull a target into a dream drops from 10 to 6, and the cooldown of Fear shortens from 20s to 14s.
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_nightmare.t:
'When the moonlight burns through the border of dream and waking, you are no longer just a prowling wild cat...
You are the nightmare incarnate, the sower of fear, the last whisper of the sleeping'
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_nightmare.a: Your fur is darker than any ordinary wild cat, as if soaked in the deepest night. Your eyes glow faint violet in the dark, and your steps make no sound — prey only senses an extra gaze by their pillow at the moment they drift into dream.
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_nightmare.p:
Whisper of Nightmares
You feed on the dreams of others and toy with their fear:

Dream: dealing 10 cumulative damage to one target (6 during the Cursed Moon) sends it to sleep. Dreaming targets cannot apply negative effects to you; your spell debuffs on them still work normally

Fear (primary): afflict all dreaming enemies: their vision compressed to 16 blocks by pink fog, slowed by 20%, haunted by a heartbeat that grows louder as you approach; their dream duration is locked, and the first hit from you or your whitelisted allies deals double damage. You are fully invisible to feared targets beyond 16 blocks; within 16 blocks you flicker (2s hidden / 0.6s visible). They cannot see you, cannot aggro you, and see you revealed for 1.5 seconds after you attack them. When fear ends they are forcibly awakened and cannot dream again for 20s. 20s cooldown (14s during the Cursed Moon)

Spook (secondary): summon a ghostly creeper only the dreaming target can see behind it, detonating harmlessly after 3s; if it turns to fight back, a ghost cat pounces at its face (12 magic damage). Against merely dreaming creatures, the invisible ghost cat bites directly (12 magic damage) and resets their dream timer. 8s cooldown

Dream Devour: dealing damage to dreaming targets restores 15% of it as health; if the target dies dreaming, restore 4 extra health

Phantom Affinity: phantoms see you as kin of the dream's edge and never hunt you

Cursed Moon Resonance: during the Cursed Moon, the dream threshold drops from 10 to 6 and Fear's cooldown from 20s to 14s

Additionally, you retain all wild cat instincts: silent steps, creeper deterrence, fall immunity, phantom intimidation, night speed and night vision.

Dreambound Casting: When a spell lands on a target still dreaming under your own mark, spell damage increases by 35% and harmful status duration increases by 35%, rounded up to a tick. Status level and strength do not change. Another Nightmare's dream does not qualify. Ordinary melee, native skills, potions and buffs are unchanged. Existing void affinity, refunds, dream feeding, Perks and accessories remain.
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_nightmare.c:
The Nightmare's Chains:

Nearly all your power targets sleeping enemies — waking foes must be handled by ordinary means

Fear and Spook only work on dreamers; the accumulate-then-harvest rhythm takes patience

Max health is 4 points lower than a normal player

You cannot wear leggings or boots; you become light-footed when night falls (Speed I).
codex.form.my_addon.wild_cat_nightmare.i: You hear every steady breath within blocks around you, silently counting the moment each falls asleep. The waking world feels noisy and dull — only when prey closes their eyes and fear seeps through the cracks of dreams does the true hunt begin.
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_wind_spirit.t:
'When the ocelot broke free from the shackles of hunting instinct, the wind became its skeleton...
You are the gale skimming the grass, the claw shadow that never stops'
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_wind_spirit.a: Your streamlined body is leaner than any ordinary ocelot, as if the patterns of wind flow through your fur. At full sprint you leave only an afterimage, landing as lightly as a blown leaf.
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_wind_spirit.p:
Form of the Gale
You regained the free sprinting power the ocelot bloodline once lost:

Gale Claws (left click): hold left click for continuous claw strikes that accelerate over time (interval drops from 1s to 0.34s), each sweeping enemies within 2.5 blocks ahead (8 base damage, decaying with duration, stacked with the weapon cooldown); the crosshair stamina bar is your combo resource — releasing or emptying it needs ~8s to refill (5.5s with the exclusive necklace), and while overheated your left click is only a weak swipe. Speed gradually decays during combos (up to -45%)

Wind Dash (primary): soar 5 blocks straight up and hover for 3s (grey smoke beneath your feet) with a green landing marker up to 16 blocks ahead along your crosshair; press primary again to dash in a straight line to the marker, dealing 12 physical damage to enemies within 3 blocks of the landing point, entering a 12s cooldown. Timing out falls gently without damage but still triggers the cooldown

Landing Surge (passive): after meaningful airtime, if you hit no enemy during it, deal 6 physical damage and knockback within 3 blocks on landing (5s internal cooldown); hitting an enemy midair suppresses it — rewarding aerial combat

Wind Pressure Field (passive): projectiles fired by non-whitelisted creatures within 8 blocks of you are slowed by 30%; projectiles from players, tamed pets, summons and yourself are unaffected

Additionally, you retain ocelot instincts: climbing all surfaces, silent steps, creeper deterrence, fall immunity, phantom intimidation, barepaw sweeping, arrow dodge and ledge clipping.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Primary-skill damage is multiplied by 1.5. During the secondary-skill buff, unarmed damage doubles on top of its existing buff (3 times base damage by default).

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Move at 30% of normal walking speed while charging any spell, bypassing its casting immobility and displacement limit. Normal sprinting, sneak-key rushing or using a form skill interrupts preparation. During a protected release stage, both rush inputs and form skills are disabled while walking remains available. A locked target or point beyond 1.5 times the accepted effective range still forces failure. Existing costs, cooldowns and space affinities remain.
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_wind_spirit.c:
The Gale's Price:

Gale Claws demand rhythm management: overheating leaves you only weak swipes, and speed decays during combos

While hovering in Wind Dash you are an obvious target; landing spots need forethought

You cannot wear chestplates, leggings or boots

Max health is 6 points lower than a normal player, and only raw meat grants better satiation.
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_wind_spirit.i: At full sprint you hear the wind parting for you. The chains binding the hunter's stance have snapped — you no longer crouch, prowl and wait; you chase, sweep past, and tear apart. Standing still is almost torture.
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_nova.title:
'The nine-lived cat's soul cycles unquenched between waxing and waning...
You are the turning point in desperation, the Nova that dies and rises'
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_nova.appearan: Your fur shimmers with an unseen lunar phase, eyes one gold and one silver, as if reflecting both new moon and full moon at once. Nine faint rings wind around your tail tip — those are your lives.
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_nova.pros:
Nine-Lived Spirit Cat
With feline resilience and agility you weave through desperation:

Nine Lives (passive): when struck down by fatal damage, automatically consume 1 life and revive on the spot: restore 6 health, gain 6 absorption hearts (30s) and 1s of invulnerability; falling again within 3s means true death. Max 8 lives; after leaving combat (10s) you regain 1 life every 20s; reviving after a true death refills all 8

Spirit Leap (secondary): dash toward your crosshair (usable in air), chainable twice with up to 5s between leaps; each use grants +20% dodge (3s). Full 2 uses = 10s cooldown; only 1 use past the window = 6s

Feline Dodge (passive): you innately have a 15% dodge chance to fully ignore one melee or ranged hit — no damage, no knockback; Spirit Leap dodge stacks on top (cap 85%)

Self-Detonation (primary): charge 5s (70% slow, Resistance III, no sprinting), then detonate consuming 1 life: 50 lethal damage within a 5-block radius, decaying out to 12 blocks; no block destruction, no friendly fire (whitelisted allies and pets immune), and the blast is always caught by Nine Lives. 30s cooldown

Additionally, you retain ocelot instincts: climbing all surfaces, silent steps, creeper deterrence, fall immunity, phantom intimidation, barepaw sweeping and ledge clipping.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Damage taken from unprotected creatures is always reduced by 25%. Primary-skill base damage rises to 100 at close range and retains distance falloff.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
For 5 seconds after a successful Nine Lives revival, skip spell preparation. Spells with a protected release stage start at that stage and keep its original animation speed. Accepted casts retain their duration after the window expires. Normal respawns do not trigger this effect. Spell costs, cooldowns and failure rules still apply.
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_nova.cons:
The Price of Nine Lives:

Your lives are not infinite: repeated deaths drain them, and only a true death refills them

Self-Detonation trades a life for damage — a turning point deep in enemy ranks, suicide if abused

Max health is 8 points lower than a normal player (two stacking reductions), and only raw meat grants better satiation

You cannot wear chestplates, leggings or boots.
codex.form.my_addon.ocelot_nova.instinct: You feel your eight remaining lives taking turns breathing inside you. Every fall and rise carves one more ring into your soul — you lost count of your deaths long ago; you only know that each time you open your eyes, the moonlight is colder, and clearer, than the last.
message.ssc_addon.tide_spirit.revert_flu: The tide washes over the glow, and the guardian spirit's pact comes to a rest—you have returned to being a Fluorescent Axolotl.
item.ssc_addon.nightmare_ring.tooltip_2: Cost: the first-hit double damage during Fear is removed
origin.my_addon.form_snow_fox_frostspine: A snow fox evolution empowered by moon marrow, retaining every instinct of the snow fox and awakening the active ice-control skill Ice Spike.
advancements.my_addon.on_transform_snow_: Transform into Frostspine for the first time
'When moon-marrow power seeps into the snow ranger's blood, you are still that nimble snow fox...
only now the moonlight gilds every leap with a new frosty gleam'
Your form is no different from a snow fox, snow-white fur glinting with a faint blue chill under the moon. You leap thrice as lightly as snow, kicking up fine powder on landing.

Snow Ranger
You fully inherit every instinct of the snow fox:

Triple Leap: jump up to three times in midair, roaming the snowfields freely with hover and fall control

Snow Stride: move 15% faster on ice and snow

Frost Thorn Aegis: orbiting thorns serve as both spear and shield — melee damage taken is reduced per thorn, and melee aggressors accumulate frost thorns that burst when full

Cold Metabolism: the chill of cold biomes and powder snow slowly mends your wounds

Snowtread: walk on powder snow without sinking, with special affinity for snowballs and sweet berries

Cold-Born Body: unbothered by the cold, with temperature sense inverted from an ordinary person

You also retain the snow fox's sprinting, fox affinity and all other instincts.

Extra effects against non-player creatures (whitelist respected):
Your damage is multiplied by 1.5.

Primary - Ice Spike: hold primary to form one orbiting thorn every 1.2 seconds, up to 5. Each lasts 60 seconds; at the cap, the oldest is replaced. Tap primary to fire them in order, with a 0.2-second firing interval.

Secondary - Frost Forge: first form orbiting thorns, then hold secondary to consume one per second and strengthen an overhead thorn. Release to fire. Movement falls to 10% while charging and primary charging is disabled. Release before consuming a thorn to cancel.

Form spell interaction (default settings):
Ice spells spend your hovering thorns' lifespan to reduce collapse growth. Defaults: each thorn spends 18 seconds and reduces cost by 5%, adding to 25% with five thorns. A thorn with less lifespan still gives the full reduction, then shatters and freezes its surroundings. Spent lifespan is not refunded on interruption.

The Snow Fox's Weakness:

You fear fire — you burn longer and take more fire damage, needing a water bottle to douse it

You cannot wear leggings or boots

Digging and moving in water are sluggish, and your biome affects your max health.
You crave snow and cold wind, and loathe heat and flame. Treading on powder snow puts you at ease, while nearing fire makes you instinctively recoil.
power.my_addon.form_snow_fox_frostspine_: Move 15% faster on ice, snow and powder snow.
While in a cold biome (biome temperature below 0.2) or standing on powder snow, recover 1 health every 3 seconds (paused while skill cooldown is active).
item.ssc_addon.frost_spine_collar.toolti: Ice Spike hits on enemies instantly refund 1 orbiting thorn for free
Refunds follow condense rules: empty slot first, replaces the oldest at 5
Cost: normal thorn hit damage reduced to 80% (8 -> 6.4)
origin.my_addon.form_spider_salticidae.d: The Evolution Stone ignites the spider's hunting instinct, transforming it into a webless, actively hunting salticidae.
advancements.my_addon.on_transform_spide: Transform into the Salticidae for the first time
codex.form.my_addon.spider_salticidae.ti:
'When the Evolution Stone's energy bursts through your veins, waiting on a web is no longer enough...
You become the salticidae — every leap a rest note for your prey.'
codex.form.my_addon.spider_salticidae.ap: The stone reshaped your body. Shrunk to 60% of an ordinary form, your eight limbs grow leaner yet stronger, compound eyes glinting with a sharp gaze — the eyes of a hunter that never builds a web.
codex.form.my_addon.spider_salticidae.pr:
Leaping Hunter
You abandon the patience of web-guarding for the strike of an active hunter:

Jump Kill (Primary): hold the primary key to charge — longer charge, greater lock range (base 3 blocks, full 3s charge → up to 16); during charge all pounceable targets glow red, the one nearest your crosshair glows green (visible only to you); release to leap along a smooth arc and pounce the locked target for 8 physical damage + Poison II 8s + Stun 0.35s. The farther the target, the higher you leap; you track moving targets in midair (with lead prediction), but a target that outruns the tolerance is missed

research.ssc_addon.ui.guide_text:
Getting started
Draw a functional symbol from the left palette, then Identify it. Discover Source, Gain and Stability to reach research rank 1. Rune assist lets you stamp the selected symbol; turn it off to draw in one stroke.

Attunement and calibration
Keep samples in your inventory, select a family and Attune: fire = magma cream, ice = snowball, lunar = amethyst shard, curse = spider eye, summon = feather, void = ender pearl, space = pearl + amethyst. Any universal family uses 1 untreated moondust and attunes all four universal families. Draw an outer ring and Calibrate; if its direction is wrong, reverse it with R and retry.

Level one
Draw an outer ring, with all runes inside. Elemental families: Source → Element → Gain → Stability. Universal families: Source → Conversion/Storage/Insight/Recovery → Stability. Wire by clicking start then end; arrows indicate energy flow.

Grammar
Exactly one Source and one terminal Stability. Elemental families need exactly one element before every Gain. Universal families have no element; different effects cannot mix. Effect count equals level. Ordinary runes have one inlet and outlet; Split has one inlet and two or three outlets, Merge the reverse. Every rune must be reachable from Source, with no cycles.

Levels two through five
Two: 1 ring, 2 branches with 1 effect each. Three: 2 rings, branches with 1 and 2 effects. Four: 2 rings, branches with 1, 1 and 2 effects. Five: 3 rings, split into 2, merge, then split into 3; 1 effect per branch. Splits and merges must pair without nesting. Each inner layer needs an effect.

Stability and bridges
Follow calibrated rules: Stability after the last effect of each branch, or immediately after merging. A terminal Stability still seals the circuit. Rings must be concentric and separated. Place a Bridge on each inner ring boundary crossed by a wire, with neighbors on opposite sides. Crossing wires do not connect.

Advancement and unlocking
After your first level-one unlock, draw a valid diagram of the next rank and Advance for free. Unlock requires rank and attunement, plus blank formation paper 1, matching formation ink × level, and untreated moondust × twice the level in the table. Leave output empty. Unlock gives one formation and enables normal scribing on the original page. Testing is free.

Exploration and sharing
Chests contain notes, incomplete and complete diagrams. Use them to record a reference, then show it here. Copy a complete reference for inventory paper 1 and ordinary formation ink 1; share it with players in the same world. References guide your drawing without filling it automatically.

Controls
Hold left click to draw rings and runes. Wire: click two runes. Move: drag. Erase: click rune, wire or ring. R reverses nearest ring; Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo, Ctrl+Delete clears. Save or Back preserves the draft.

research.ssc_addon.ui.drawing_guide:
Brush and eraser
Hold the left mouse button to draw. Closed circular strokes become rings, strokes between nodes become wires, and other strokes are recognized as runes. Hold the right button to erase runes, wires and rings; one erase gesture is one undo step. Ctrl+Z/Y undo or redo. Ctrl+Delete clears and can be undone.

Drawing assistance
Select a symbol and click empty canvas to place it, without revealing unknown meanings. Click existing nodes in sequence to connect them; Esc ends the chain. Select a rune and drag its upper-right move handle. Click a ring's right-hand arrow, or point at it and press R, to reverse it. Uncertain recognition offers the detected symbol or your selected symbol; Esc cancels.

Basic research
Identify Source, Gain and Stability in the notebook to reach rank I. Keep attunement samples in your inventory: fire uses magma cream, ice a snowball, lunar an amethyst shard, curse a spider eye, summon a feather, void an ender pearl, space a pearl and an amethyst shard, one each. One untreated moondust attunes all universal families. On the Formation page, draw an outer ring and calibrate to record world rules.

Formations
Level one: Source → Element → Gain → Stability. Universal formations omit the element and use Conversion, Storage, Insight or Recovery instead of Gain. Keep every node inside the outer ring and reachable from the single Source to the single terminal Stability; no cycles. Ordinary nodes have one inlet and outlet; Split has two or three outlets, Merge the reverse. Element precedes all Gain nodes; effects cannot mix.

Higher formations
Two: 1 ring, 2 branches with 1 effect each. Three: 2 rings, branches with 1 and 2 effects. Four: 2 rings, branches with 1, 1 and 2 effects. Five: 3 rings, a two-branch group then a three-branch group, 1 effect each. Branches must not nest; every inner layer needs an effect. Follow the world's branch or post-merge stability rule and end at Stability. Each inner boundary crossing needs a Bridge with neighbors on opposite sides.

Spells
Choose a spell to see its signature reference. Draw one ring and connect Source, Element (omitted for universal spells), six signature symbols and terminal Stability in reference order. Positions may vary. Signature symbols identify the spell and do not apply formation effect or branch rules. The reference can be hidden. At rank I, with the family attuned, a correct drawing unlocks the atlas without granting a scroll. Craft or upgrade using the workshop's existing costs and level restrictions. Recording a red-rarity atlas does not bypass its crafting restriction.

Materials and drafts
Testing costs no materials. First formation unlock needs blank formation paper 1, matching ink × level, untreated moondust × level × 2 and an empty output slot at the table. Unlock a level-one formation before drawing the next rank and advancing in the notebook. Each page saves its own draft. Returning or closing saves it. Changing the selected spell retains your drawing for editing and retests against the new target.

research.ssc_addon.runes.rules:
Assembly rules
Gold foundation slots define the spell; blue outer slots enhance it. Levels 2-5 have 5, 5, 8 and 12 outer slots. Level 1 has no enhancements.

An empty outer ring produces an ordinary scroll with ordinary information. Fill an enhancement ring completely to test and finish; imprint its scheme to obtain a Modified scroll. Partial drafts can be saved. The first and last outer slots are adjacent; foundation slots do not participate.

Stability
Starts at 100; minimum 20. Stable restores a net 10 while retaining mana and charge costs. Next to participating Gain or Merge, it removes at most 2 extra load per charged relationship, without reducing mana, charge time or cooldown.

Adjacent combinations
Gain + Merge: power contributions +25%; each edge adds load 6 and cooldown +8%.
Gain + Store: Charged Burst adds damage +12%, charge +8 ticks, cooldown +15%, load 8.
Source + Store: Heavy Projectile adds damage +6%, speed +5%, cooldown +10%, load 6.
Split + Convert: Sustained Pressure adds area +8%, negative duration +10%, mana +10%, cooldown +12%, load 6.
Recover + Merge: Focused Mending adds healing +12%, charge +4 ticks, cooldown +10%, load 6.

Each new resonance grants and charges once per ring. All required properties must have real consumers. Unsupported resonance adds no extra fees; individual rune costs remain. Protection discounts each charged package at most once.

Bridge + Split reduces positive contributions by 25%. Disable + Gain halves both effects.

Forbidden neighbors
Split + Merge, Store + Stable, Disable + Store, Disable + Bridge. Identical neighbors are forbidden except up to three Stable runes counting across the seam.

Inspect effects
Hover slots for contributions and adjacent interactions. Open Scheme and scroll through base contributions, interaction changes, actual capped effects and book or solo costs. Different resonances combine, with costs retained beyond effect caps.

Natural scrolls
New drops have no rune enhancement. Analysis reveals the foundation for your outer assembly. Registered old schemes retain their frozen effects and costs.

Replaces Mana Capacity I: increase player mana capacity by 50, for a capacity of 150 without other bonuses. Mark and teleport costs stay fixed; execution rewards still restore mana to the actual maximum.
Allow Speed, Haste and Invisibility at level I with their normal duration. Keep all other Mancianima immunities; no potion-duration penalty is added.
Replaces Permeable Field I and additionally allows Strength, Water Breathing and Night Vision. All six effects are limited to level I with their normal duration. Other Mancianima immunities remain.

Pick up paper in your inventory and right-click a glistering melon slice, fermented spider eye or spider eye. Spend 5 mana to craft a strong healing, harming or poison charm. Mancianima can fire the original charms, with a 1-second cooldown per type.
perk.ssc_addon.golden_sandstorm_sp.anubi: Reduces Wither Sand's successful-release cooldown by 3 seconds (26 to 23 by default). Its interruption cooldown is unchanged.
Replaces rank I: reduces Wither Sand's successful-release cooldown by 6 seconds in total (26 to 20 by default). Does not stack with rank I or reduce interruption cooldown.

Increases the health-damage ratio and cap of passive brand bursts and active detonations by 25%: normally 20% to 25%, cap 20 to 25; Withered Sand Ring cap 26 to 32.5. Accessory splash is not amplified a second time.

Passive: each eligible Wither Sand hit adds 2 brand stacks, still capped at 3. Preserves green protection and stacking intervals, without an extra burst from the bonus stack. Normal melee and accessory splash stack gains are unchanged.
Permanently grants 2 maximum health while in this form. Does not grant an immediate heal.
Replaces rank I: grants 4 maximum health in total while in this form. Does not stack with rank I or grant an immediate heal.

Skill key 3, standing or sneaking: consumes your eligible non-green brands in the current dimension, healing 2% maximum health per stack, up to 20% per cast. Does not trigger bursts, splash or detonation healing. Cooldown 15 seconds; no cooldown without an eligible brand.
Removes the damage penalty against undead: hits with at least 4 raw damage no longer lose 3 base damage.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_desmodus.bat_posture_: Reduces the ground movement penalty from 20% to 12%. Does not remove the additional sunlight penalty.
Replaces rank I: reduces the ground movement penalty to 6%, without stacking ranks. Does not remove the additional sunlight penalty.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_desmodus.bat_echoloca: Passively enhances nighttime sonar: range 12 to 16 blocks, pulsing every 3 seconds with 3 seconds of glow. Enemies also receive Weakness I for 3 seconds; whitelisted targets are exempt from Weakness. Works indoors at night. Adds no daytime activation and does not use skill key 2.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_desmodus.bat_wingbeat: While gliding, press skill key 3 to add 1.5 forward velocity at a direct cost of 1 food point (half a food icon). Requires at least 1 food point. Cooldown 2 seconds; does not activate Mist Form or Sonic Wave.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_desmodus.bat_arrow_th: Right-click while holding an arrow in your main hand to throw it at speed 3.0. Cooldown 1 second; consumes one arrow outside Creative mode and preserves the arrow type and potion effects.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_desmodus.bat_sun_resi: In sunlight, grants +3 attack damage attribute while empty-handed or holding an item SSC does not classify as a weapon. Existing attack multipliers still apply. Does not reduce sunlight weakness, bloodthirst decay or the sunlight maximum-health penalty.

Replaces rank I: grants +6 attack damage attribute in total under the same sunlight and hand conditions. Existing attack multipliers still apply. Does not reduce sunlight weakness, bloodthirst decay or the sunlight maximum-health penalty.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_parasitic_fruit.bat_p: Reduces the ground movement penalty from 20% to 12%.
Replaces rank I: reduces the ground movement penalty to 6%, without stacking ranks.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_parasitic_fruit.bat_e: Passive nighttime sonar: every 3 seconds, reveals living targets within 16 blocks with 3 seconds of glow. Enemies also receive Weakness I for 3 seconds; whitelisted targets are exempt from Weakness. Works indoors at night, remains inactive during daytime and does not use skill key 2.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_parasitic_fruit.bat_w: While gliding, press skill key 3 to add 1.5 forward velocity at a direct cost of 1 food point (half a food icon). Requires at least 1 food point. Cooldown 2 seconds; does not activate Parasitic Spiritfruit or Infection Spore Bomb.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_parasitic_fruit.bat_a: Right-click while holding an arrow in your main hand to throw it at speed 3.0. Cooldown 1 second; consumes one arrow outside Creative mode and preserves the arrow type and potion effects.
perk.ssc_addon.bat_parasitic_fruit.bat_s: In sunlight, grants +3 attack damage attribute while empty-handed or holding an item SSC does not classify as a weapon. Existing attack multipliers still apply. Does not change Seed Energy.
Replaces rank I: grants +6 attack damage attribute in total under the same sunlight and hand conditions, without stacking ranks. Existing attack multipliers still apply. Does not change Seed Energy.
perk.ssc_addon.spider_moon_weaver.spider: Reduces the ground walking and sprinting speed penalty from 20% to 10%. Inactive in water.
Raises the fluid cocoon drop chance from cocooned kills from 40% to 55%, retaining SSC's drop blacklist and kill ownership checks.
Replaces rank I: raises the fluid cocoon drop chance from cocooned kills to 65%, without stacking ranks. Retains SSC's drop blacklist and kill ownership checks.

Enhances the primary skill's bridge mode, including flat bridges and bridge shots: charge thresholds become 14/28/42 ticks (0.7/1.4/2.1 seconds), while cumulative tier costs remain 5/10/15 mana. Preserves cooldowns and early release behavior; does not use the secondary key. Values shown use default configuration.

Touching or standing on cobwebs, bridge webs or web membranes reveals living targets within 32 blocks and refreshes 1 second of Strength II every 0.5 seconds. Existing Web Affinity remains independent.

Enhances the primary skill's attack mode: charge thresholds become 14/28/42 ticks (0.7/1.4/2.1 seconds), while cumulative tier costs remain 5/10/15 mana. Preserves cooldowns and early release behavior. Does not affect bridge mode or swinging. Values shown use default configuration.
Right-click one cobweb with another in your inventory to consume 2 cobwebs and 10 web mana, producing 1 original fully charged web projectile item usable in any form.
Raises base web mana regeneration from 0.2 to 0.35 per second, stacking independently with Web Affinity's 1 mana per second.
Replaces rank I: raises base web mana regeneration to 0.5 per second without stacking ranks. Stacks independently with Web Affinity's 1 mana per second.
perk.ssc_addon.spider_salticidae.spider_: Reduces the ground walking and sprinting speed penalty from 20% to 10%. Inactive in water.
A direct Jump Kill defeat against an unprotected target restores 2 health (1 heart). Later poison kills, normal melee and other players' kills do not trigger this healing.

Replaces rank I: a direct Jump Kill defeat against an unprotected target restores 4 health (2 hearts), without stacking ranks. Later poison kills, normal melee and other players' kills do not trigger this healing.
Reduces full Jump Kill charge time from 3 to 2.1 seconds (42 ticks). Targeting range remains 3 to 16 blocks and safety silk rules are retained. Values shown use default configuration.

While charging Jump Kill, reveals living targets within 32 blocks. Actual locking still obeys Jump Kill's targeting range. A Jump Kill hit that removes real health grants Strength II for 3 seconds. Fully absorbed or shielded hits do not grant it.
Reduces the secondary venom skill cooldown from 10 to 7 seconds for both normal spray and the safety silk dash. Values shown use default configuration.

Increases the three direct venom damage values by 25%: spray 4 to 5, dash collision 2 to 2.5, burst 6 to 7.5. Does not increase poison tick damage. Venom Gland and non-player multipliers are retained. Values shown are default base damage.
Reduces successful and missed Jump Kill cooldowns by 15%: hit 12 to 10.2 seconds, miss 8 to 6.8 seconds. Values shown use default configuration.
Replaces rank I: reduces successful and missed Jump Kill cooldowns by 25%, without stacking ranks. Hit 12 to 9 seconds, miss 8 to 6 seconds. Values shown use default configuration.
perk.ssc_addon.upgrade_axolotl.axolotl_v: On vegetation, reduces base moisture loss from 3 to 1 per second. The extra 3 moisture lost every 2 seconds before Become Water is retained. Does not change walking speed.
perk.ssc_addon.upgrade_axolotl.axolotl_d: Permanently adds 6 maximum health regardless of moisture. Without other bonuses, raises maximum health from 22 to 28.
perk.ssc_addon.upgrade_axolotl.axolotl_m: A critical hit dealing more than 7 actual damage to an enemy restores 15 moisture. Retains the original trigger conditions.
Replaces rank I: a critical hit dealing more than 7 actual damage to an enemy restores 30 moisture below 150 moisture, otherwise 15. Ranks do not stack.
perk.ssc_addon.upgrade_axolotl.axolotl_p: After unlocking Water Propulsion, reduces land sprint-jump propulsion moisture cost from 3 to 1 while retaining its original movement.
perk.ssc_addon.upgrade_axolotl.axolotl_w: After unlocking Water Spurt, reduces land dash moisture cost from 12 to 6. Underwater dash remains free, with the original input and 5-second cooldown. Values shown use default configuration.
After unlocking Throw Water Spear, reduces its moisture cost from 18 to 10. Vortex Guide remains free and retains its healing effects. Values shown use default configuration.
perk.ssc_addon.upgrade_axolotl.axolotl_t: Requires Vortex Guide. Hold skill key 3 to spend 20 moisture and mark a creature under the crosshair within 20 blocks. Release to pull and launch it, granting Slow Falling for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 1 second.
perk.ssc_addon.upgrade_familiar_fox.fami: Requires Mana System. While not blocking and above 5 mana, take 50% less projectile damage at a cost of 5 mana per hit.
Requires Mana System. Successfully blocking a projectile while sneaking with at least 5 mana spends 5 mana to fire a fireball at the attacker.
Requires Mana System. Each hit that removes more than 0.1 health from an enemy restores 2 mana, with no extra cooldown. Fully blocked or absorbed hits do not restore mana.
Requires Mana System. Each hit that removes more than 0.1 health from an enemy restores 4 mana, with no extra cooldown. Fully blocked or absorbed hits do not restore mana. Replaces rank I.
Requires Mana System. Adds 25 to final maximum mana, unaffected by the progression form's base capacity multiplier. Mana Shield still activates at 50% of maximum mana.
Requires Mana System. Adds 50 to final maximum mana, unaffected by the progression form's base capacity multiplier. Replaces rank I. Mana Shield still activates at 50% of maximum mana.
Requires Buff Immunity. Allows Speed, Haste and Invisibility at level I with their normal potion duration. All other immunities, including fire immunity, remain.
Requires Buff Immunity. Also allows Strength, Water Breathing and Night Vision at level I with their normal potion duration. Replaces rank I. All other immunities, including fire immunity, remain.

Requires Alchemy to craft and use potion charms. Combine paper with a Glistering Melon Slice, Fermented Spider Eye or Spider Eye to craft a Healing, Harming or Poison Charm for 5 mana. Using a charm has a 1-second cooldown.

power.my_addon.form_snow_fox_sp_ice_prep: A successful native frost skill hit briefly reduces collapse growth for your next ice spell. Defaults: 15% reduction within 3 seconds. Further hits refresh the window without stacking. Consumed when ice casting starts; interruption does not refund it.
power.my_addon.form_snow_fox_frostspine_: Ice spells spend your hovering thorns' lifespan to reduce collapse growth. Defaults: each thorn spends 18 seconds and reduces cost by 5%, adding to 25% with five thorns. A thorn with less lifespan still gives the full reduction, then shatters and freezes its surroundings. Spent lifespan is not refunded on interruption.
power.my_addon.form_ocelot_wind_spirit_m: Move at 30% of normal walking speed while charging any spell, bypassing its casting immobility and displacement limit. Normal sprinting, sneak-key rushing or using a form skill interrupts preparation. During a protected release stage, both rush inputs and form skills are disabled while walking remains available. A locked target or point beyond 1.5 times the accepted effective range still forces failure. Existing costs, cooldowns and space affinities remain.
power.my_addon.form_ocelot_nova_quick_ca: For 5 seconds after a successful Nine Lives revival, skip spell preparation. Spells with a protected release stage start at that stage and keep its original animation speed. Accepted casts retain their duration after the window expires. Normal respawns do not trigger this effect. Spell costs, cooldowns and failure rules still apply.
message.ssc_addon.spell.range_exceeded: Casting failed: the locked target is beyond 1.5 times the spell range.
power.my_addon.form_allay_sp_spell_relay: Each wounded player restores at least 0.25 health per hit, capped at maximum health. Share 25% of actual enemy health lost to your spells equally as healing among wounded whitelisted players within 16 blocks of you, including yourself. Full-health players take no share; pets, summons, self/ally damage, absorption and overkill do not contribute. After actual healing, pay 15% of this cast's actual collapse cost once per cast. Existing lunar cooldown, summoning affinity, native abilities, Perks and accessories remain.
power.my_addon.form_fallen_allay_sp_spel: A direct curse hit copies its effect to the nearest visible unprotected enemy within 5 blocks of the original target. Includes Curse Mark and Dread Whisper. At most one extra target per cast; no recursive chains or original-target duplication. Self-centered persistent effects such as Corrupt Mist do not trigger it. After a successful chain, pay 15% of this cast's actual collapse cost once. Existing curse duration, curse refunds, native abilities, Perks and accessories remain.
codex.form.my_addon.spider_moon_weaver.e: Retains spider extra-arm tools and accessories; no additional exclusive items.
codex.form.my_addon.spider_salticidae.in: Waiting in a web no longer satisfies you. Corners, branches and overhead beams become ambush points; a moment of hesitation is enough to make you leap.
codex.form.my_addon.spider_moon_weaver.i: Every tremor along a strand tugs at your senses. You seek high, sheltered corners and weave familiar paths into your web.
codex.form.my_addon.sheep_spell_form.tit: A spell has temporarily changed your appearance.
codex.form.my_addon.sheep_spell_form.app: You temporarily appear as a sheep and return to your previous form when the spell ends.
codex.form.my_addon.sheep_spell_form.pro: A temporary spell transformation, outside the selectable evolution paths.
codex.form.my_addon.sheep_spell_form.con: Restrictions and duration depend on the transforming spell.
codex.form.my_addon.sheep_spell_form.ins: This transformation grants no new form instincts.

recipe.ssc_addon.loot_frost_spine_collar: The Frost Spine Collar has no crafting recipe. Find one in igloo chests (15% chance) or dungeon chests (10% chance). This necklace is exclusive to the Frostspine Fox form.
recipe.ssc_addon.loot_ankh_stone: The Ankh Stone has no crafting recipe. Desert temple chests have a 15% chance to contain 1-2. This ring accessory is exclusive to the SP Anubis Wolf form and is consumed when its revival enhancement triggers.
recipe.ssc_addon.venom: Use any regular, long or strong poison potion, in a drinkable, splash or lingering bottle, surrounded by eight spider eyes.
recipe.ssc_addon.infinite: The compressed energy potion can be drinkable, splash or lingering. The whole pattern may also move down one row.
recipe.ssc_addon.moon_ring: Gold belongs in the corners and a morphscale core in the center. Each of the four side materials is used once; their positions may be exchanged.
recipe.ssc_addon.refill: Shapeless: an axolotl bucket fills the moisturizer to its current level capacity. Its level, name and other data are preserved. The preview starts empty.
recipe.ssc_addon.upgrade_moisturizer: The center moisturizer must have the shown level. Upgrading preserves its existing charge, name and other data. The preview starts empty.
recipe.ssc_addon.reload: Shapeless: each snowball or snow layer slot adds 1 shot; each snow block slot adds 8, up to 20. Multiple ammo slots work. The example starts empty; existing ammo and other data are preserved.
recipe.ssc_addon.recharge: Shapeless: each snow block slot adds 8 charge, up to 64. Multiple snow block slots work; a full tank cannot recharge. The example starts empty; other data is preserved.
recipe.ssc_addon.bottling: Each bottle costs one glass bottle and %s network energy and takes %s seconds, producing a universal energy potion. Connect the network above or beside the bottler and select manual or automatic mode. Three lines work independently.
recipe.ssc_addon.infusion: Place the spellbook in an infusion altar. Each untreated moondust restores 10 mana; each moondust crystal shard restores 80. Once its experience requirement is met, consume one crystal shard and one morphscale core and click Upgrade. This fills mana and preserves equipped scrolls and formations.
recipe.ssc_addon.formation: Record and learn a formation first, then scribe it at a research table with one blank formation paper and school ink equal to its level. Universal formations use normal ink.
recipe.ssc_addon.scroll_workshop: Use the research table scroll workshop. Directed crafting requires a recorded atlas and is limited to low-level, non-red spells, using blank paper, school ink and untreated moondust. Upgrading needs an identified main scroll and atlas, school ink and crystals for higher levels. Repair and salvage are also available. Current costs follow the workshop and server settings.
recipe.ssc_addon.rune_research: Identify runes and test your layout at a research table. Completion uses one blank paper, plus one school ink and one untreated moondust per filled rune. An empty outer ring produces an ordinary scroll. Outer enhancements produce a scheme to imprint onto an identified scroll of the same spell and level. Rune meanings vary by save.
recipe.ssc_addon.analysis: Identify unknown scrolls or formations at the research table before recording them or using them for upgrades, research or imprinting. This information does not reveal solved rune layouts.

power.my_addon.form_bat_desmodus_blood_c: If at least 15 Blood is available when casting starts, automatically pay 15 Blood to reduce this cast's collapse growth by 35%. Otherwise cast normally without this fee. Pay once per cast; interruption does not refund it. Existing blood feedback, Lunar Mend bonus, native abilities, Perks and accessories remain.
power.my_addon.form_bat_parasitic_fruit_: Non-red spells carrying harmful status effects cost 25% more collapse and make those effects contagious. Excludes burning, knockback, instant damage and buffs. Unprotected creatures become infected after continuously staying within a 3-block sphere of a carrier for more than 2.5 seconds; leaving resets exposure. Each carrier infects at most 2 others. Initial hits are generation 1; generation 3 cannot transmit. Copy only remaining duration; cleansing, death or effect expiry stops that carrier. No cyclic reinfection within a cast. Existing summoning affinity, seed sowing, native abilities, Perks and accessories remain.
neomagic.bat_link_record: Bat link: Blood paid %s, additional infections %s
power.my_addon.form_wild_cat_sp_hidden_c: Starting a spell while invisible from the primary skill retains that specific invisibility until the spell releases or is interrupted, even beyond its original duration. Works with spellbooks, standalone scrolls and blueprints; ink invisibility is excluded. Manual cancellation, purification, death and form changes still end invisibility normally. Existing skills, Perks and accessories remain.
power.my_addon.form_wild_cat_nightmare_d: When a spell lands on a target still dreaming under your own mark, spell damage increases by 35% and harmful status duration increases by 35%, rounded up to a tick. Status level and strength do not change. Another Nightmare's dream does not qualify. Ordinary melee, native skills, potions and buffs are unchanged. Existing void affinity, refunds, dream feeding, Perks and accessories remain.
